---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Ethan Katz"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb")
dbplyr_dist <- dplyr::tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")

district_2015 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  dplyr::filter(year == 2015) |>
  dplyr::select(district_id, rla_2015 = rla_score)

district_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  dplyr::filter(year == 2023) |>
  dplyr::select(district_id, rla_2023 = rla_score)

score_change <- dplyr::inner_join(district_2015, district_2023, by = "district_id") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rla_2015), !is.na(rla_2023)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  dplyr::select(district_id, rla_change) |>
  dplyr::collect()

state_scores <- dplyr::tbl(con, "state_scores")
state_2015 <- state_scores |>
  dplyr::filter(year == 2015) |>
  dplyr::select(stateabb, rla_2015 = rla_score)

state_2023 <- state_scores |>
  dplyr::filter(year == 2023) |>
  dplyr::select(stateabb, rla_2023 = rla_score)

state_change <- dplyr::inner_join(state_2015, state_2023, by = "stateabb") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rla_2015), !is.na(rla_2023)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  dplyr::collect()

state_change
```

```{r}
ggplot2::ggplot(score_change, ggplot2::aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#4C78A8", "TRUE" = "#F58518"),
    labels = c("Non-positive", "Positive")
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "District Changes in Reading Scores",
    subtitle = paste("2015 to 2023 |", nrow(score_change), "districts"),
    x = "Change in RLA score",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Score change",
    caption = "Positive values indicate higher RLA scores in 2023 than in 2015."
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot2::ggplot(
  state_change,
  ggplot2::aes(y = forcats::fct_reorder(stateabb, rla_2023))
) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = rla_2015,
      xend = rla_2023,
      yend = forcats::fct_reorder(stateabb, rla_2023),
      color = rla_change > 0
    ),
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.15, "cm"))
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(x = rla_2015)) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#4C78A8", "TRUE" = "#F58518"),
    labels = c("Non-positive", "Positive")
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = "RLA scores from 2015 to 2023",
    x = "RLA score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Score change"
  )
```
